# Filtrete

> Filtrete by 3M provides advanced home air filtration solutions with smart technology, particle capture ratings, and allergen-friendly options for improving indoor air quality.

Filtrete is 3M's home air filtration brand offering a range of HVAC filters with varying MPR and MERV ratings, complemented by a smart app for filter management and air quality monitoring. The site helps consumers find the right filters for their needs and provides educational resources on air quality and energy efficiency.

## Key Topics

- Filtrete Smart App
- MPR Rating (Microparticle Performance Rating)
- MERV Rating
- Air Filtration
- HVAC Filters
- Allergen Control
- Asthma & Allergy Friendly
- Refillable Air Filter Kit
- Air Quality Monitoring
- Home Air Quality
- Particle Capture
- Smart Filters
- 3M Products
- Filter Finder Tool
- Energy Savings

## Product Selection & Tools

- [Filtrete Home Filtration Products](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete): Filtrete brand homepage featuring 3-in-1 air filter technology and complete product overview
- [Filter Finder - Select the right Filtrete Air Filter for Your Home](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/product-finder): Interactive tool to find ideal Filtrete air filters by particle capture needs and home requirements
- [Where to Buy Filtrete Air Filters](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/wheretobuy): Store locator for purchasing Filtrete air filters from retailers nationwide

## Smart Technology & Air Quality

- [Filtrete Smart App - Manage Home Air Quality](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/smart-app): Filtrete Smart App for monitoring air quality and managing filter changes with smart notifications
- [Elevate Your Home's Air Quality](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/virusandbacteria): Filtrete high-MPR filters engineered to capture airborne particles, viruses, and bacteria
- [Asthma & Allergy Friendly Air Filters](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/aafa): Filtrete filters meeting AAFA and ASL standards for allergy and asthma sufferers

## Resources & Education

- [Home Tips for Better Air Quality - Resource Hub](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/home-tips): Expert-backed articles and tips for improving indoor air quality and maintaining healthy homes
- [How to Save Money by Saving Energy at Home](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/energy-savings): Guide on energy efficiency benefits and cost savings from using Filtrete filters

## Customer Support

- [Support for Filtrete Brand Products](https://www.filtrete.com/3M/en_US/filtrete/support): Customer support hub with FAQ, troubleshooting guides, and contact options for Filtrete products
